daily_report_items: SOFI's 1 September close breached its lower Bollinger band, but current primary evidence did not show a new fundamental break. The lower USD 17.05 mark lifts expected return to 18.62% and produces a Buy rating, while inadequate downside payoff and a pending causal relationship keep allocation ineligible; one dependent digital-finance-rails relationship review was queued.

evidence.claim: The filed Q2 2026 Form 10-Q confirms USD 1.218676 billion of quarterly net revenue, USD 156.592 million of net income, USD 45.540 billion of deposits, a 15.3% SoFi Bank total risk-based capital ratio, and a 4.8% weighted-average personal-loan default assumption versus 4.5% at year-end.

The canonical 2026-09-01 close was USD 17.049999237060547, below the USD 17.42 lower Bollinger band, with RSI 48.4 and no coincident SMA or MACD crossing; the alert is a risk/watch transition rather than evidence of a new fundamental event.

The current immutable assessment links predecessor assessment_1c9ade30dbdac5102ac3 and this operation, matches the current security-page hash, and is allocation-ineligible for bear_base_payoff_below_minimum, expected_bear_payoff_below_minimum, and relationship_pending.

research_developments.summary: Completed one bounded SoFi Technologies security review after the 2026-09-01 lower-Bollinger-band breach. Registered the Q2 Form 10-Q and refreshed the Q2 results source, updated the security page and structured security row, and accepted immutable assessment assessment_424f36db4f1c8f0973d8. At USD 17.049999237060547, unchanged bear/base/bull fair values of USD 11.25/USD 20.90/USD 32.00 at 30%/50%/20% produce USD 20.225 probability-weighted fair value, 18.6217061877524711325856672% expected return, and 13.9662796408143533494392504% confidence-adjusted expected return. The deterministic rating is Buy with an Initiate portfolio action, but allocation remains ineligible because bear/base and expected/bear payoff tests fail and the relationship is pending. Enqueued one dependent relationship review for the plausible digital-finance-and-crypto-rails edge. No strategy, signal, order, allocation, fill, execution, cash, portfolio, performance, or accounting state changed.
